name: Compile URL( url ; hash )
purpose: Web viewer bridge helper: returns url + "#" + the hash object (JSON) for the web app. Requires a url, wraps a non-JSON hash as {value}, URL-encodes the hash on macOS and iOS (platform 1 or 3), and on Windows with a hash over 2000 characters copies it to a global text field named "CopyPasteField" through the clipboard and returns "#giant" so the web app reads the hash from the clipboard.
writes: by name: global text field on layout object "CopyPasteField" = $hash (Insert Calculated Result step 41, global: Windows only, hash over 2000 characters)
external: Copy (clipboard hand-off of a long URL hash, step 42; Windows only)
open_question: Platform codes: Get(SystemPlatform) 1/3 are tested for URL-encoding and -2 for the Windows clipboard path (as written in the script). Uses the layout-object name "CopyPasteField" while the error text says "WebViewer.CopyPastField" (typo). Private to the fm-webviewer-bridge module; the web app contract (hash format "#giant") is outside the DDR.
